# DonutChart

Donut chart: a pie chart drawn as a ring. The same rules apply: a few parts of one whole, read at a glance; to
compare close values use a BarChart, and for part-to-whole prefer SegmentedBar.

**Interaction**: the same as PieChart: each slice is a hover target, `←` / `→`, `Home` / `End` and `Esc` on
the keyboard, legend toggles and the table view.

**Category**: Charts · **Common uses**: The same uses as PieChart, when a ring fits the layout better

## Import

```ts
import { DonutChart } from 'vellum-ui'
```

## Basic usage

The same as a pie chart, drawn as a ring. Slices are separated by a 2 px gap and carry no numbers: the legend,
the tooltip and the table do.

```tsx
import { DonutChart } from 'vellum-ui'

const plans = [
  { key: 'free', name: 'Free', value: 1240 },
  { key: 'team', name: 'Team', value: 860 },
  { key: 'business', name: 'Business', value: 410 },
  { key: 'enterprise', name: 'Enterprise', value: 95 },
]

export function Basic() {
  return <DonutChart title="Accounts by plan" data={plans} nameLabel="Plan" valueLabel="Accounts" />
}
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data` | `readonly PieChartDatum[]` | The items. Colors follow the position in this array (or `slot`), so hiding or folding items never changes the color of the others. | — | Yes |
| `maxSlices` | `number` | Most slices drawn: beyond it, the largest `maxSlices - 1` items are kept and the rest are folded into "Other" (muted color). The table view still lists every item. At most 8. | `6` | No |
| `format` | `ValueFormat` | How values are written in the tooltip and the table. | `'auto'` | No |
| `nameLabel` | `string` | Header of the name column of the table view, "Category" by default (follows `locale`). | — | No |
| `valueLabel` | `string` | Header of the value column of the table view, "Value" by default (follows `locale`). | — | No |
| `title` | `string` | Title of the chart: what is plotted. It is also the accessible name of the graphic. | — | No |
| `description` | `string` | A short description under the title, such as the period or the unit. | — | No |
| `height` | `number` | Height of the graphic in pixels, axis labels included. The states take the same height. The table view starts at this height and grows with its rows up to 480 px (or this height when it is taller); only longer tables scroll. | `240` | No |
| `loading` | `boolean` | Loading: without data, a delayed loading indicator takes the place of the graphic; with data, the previous graphic stays at reduced opacity until the new data arrives. | — | No |
| `error` | `ReactNode` | Error: `true` shows the default error state; a node is shown as the message of the error state. | — | No |
| `onRetry` | `() => void` | Retry after an error; shows a "Retry" button in the error state. | — | No |
| `emptyDescription` | `ReactNode` | Text of the empty state when there is no data, "No data" by default (follows `locale`). | — | No |
| `actions` | `ReactNode` | Actions in the top-right corner, before the view switch (for example a menu or a time range). | — | No |
| `plain` | `boolean` | Without the card (no background, shadow or padding), for charts inside a Panel, a dialog or a drawer. | — | No |

Also accepts `testId` (rendered as `data-testid`), `aria-label`, `role` and `id`, like all primitives.

Does not accept `style` or `className`: appearance is adjusted only through the semantic props above and the theme.

## Types

Types of this library used above. Import them with `import type { … } from 'vellum-ui'`.

### PieChartDatum

A slice of a pie or donut chart.

| Field | Type | Description | Default | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `key` | `string` | Identity of the item. | — | Yes |
| `name` | `string` | Name of the item in the legend, the tooltip and the table; shown as text, never interpreted as HTML. | — | Yes |
| `value` | `number` | The value; zero, negative and missing values draw no slice but are listed in the table. | — | Yes |
| `slot` | `1 \| 2 \| 3 \| 4 \| 5 \| 6 \| 7 \| 8` | Pins the color of the item to a position of the categorical palette (by default its position in `data`). | — | No |

### ValueFormat

How a value is written.
- `'auto'`: in full below 10,000, compact from 10,000 on (1,284 · 12.9K · 4.2M).
- `'number'`: always in full, with grouping separators.
- `'compact'`: always compact.
- `'percent'`: the value is a ratio (0.125 → 12.5%).
- a function: your own formatting (units, currencies).

```ts
type ValueFormat = 'auto' | 'number' | 'compact' | 'percent' | ((value: number) => string)
```
